name: auryn-php
summary: PHP language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-php engine extracting namespaces/classes/interfaces/traits/enums/functions/methods/properties/constants/params, the type hierarchy (EXTENDS/IMPLEMENTS/USES_TRAIT), and calls. A deep pass (full name-resolution: use-statement aliasing, autoloading, inherited-member calls) is the planned second phase.
